rationale: The agent did look up the user by name and ZIP and retrieved user and order details, but then performed order-changing writes without first confirming with the user, violating the policy. Specifically, it executed modify_pending_order_address and modify_pending_order_items without any explicit confirmation step. Additionally, the request to exchange the Bluetooth Speaker to the cheapest green type was not substantiated by tool use: only a single get_product_details call was made for one product, and the replacement item_id differs with no evidence it is the cheapest green option. The final user message contains no summary of actions or results. These issues fail the pass bar requirements for confirmation before writes and correctness/supported information.
